entities.summary: Jack Wilson McConnell, Baron McConnell of Glenscorrodale, is a Scottish politician who served as First Minister of Scotland and Leader of the Labour Party in Scotland from 2001 to 2007. McConnell served as the Minister for Finance from 1999 to 2000 and Minister for Education, Europe and External Affairs from 2000 to 2001. He has been a Labour life peer in the House of Lords since 2010 and previously served as a Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) for Motherwell and Wishaw from 1999 to 2011. McConnell held the Presidency of the Conference of European Regions with Legislative Power (REGLEG) during November 2003 to November 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As First Minister of Scotland and Leader of the Labour Party in Scotland from 2001 to 2007, Jack McConnell played a key role in shaping Scotland's devolution process and its relations with the European Union. His tenure as President of REGLEG also highlighted his influence on regional politics.
